verdict.rationale: Shared docs and notes are a fair question for a work-management product, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents a native Asana docs, notes, or wiki feature. The closest items are third-party integrations: Notion pages can preview and sync Asana tasks, and Canva and Figma designs can be embedded. These put the docs in other tools rather than showing Asana itself lets you create and organize them.
